description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity for a leader committed to delivering exceptional patient care and supporting a dynamic nursing team. We are specifically looking for candidates seeking a stable, long-term role within our compassionate environment.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in the daily operations of the nursing department, assisting the Director of Nursing in ensuring the highest standards of clinical care, regulatory compliance, and staff development. You will help foster a positive and supportive work environment, contributing to both resident well-being and team success.

If you are a passionate RN with leadership aspirations and a desire to make a lasting impact in a skilled nursing facility, we encourage you to apply. This role offers a chance to grow your career in a supportive setting.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of clinical nursing experience, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or leadership capacity.
Experience within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting is highly preferred.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
